mapper.select: SELECT place_id, summary, positive_points, negative_points, recommended_for, keywords, review_count, model_version, status, last_review_updated_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM place_review_summaries WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_review_summaries ( place_id, summary, positive_points, negative_points, recommended_for, keywords, review_count, model_version, status, last_review_updated_at, error_message ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{summary}, #{positivePoints, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{negativePoints, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{recommendedFor, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{keywords, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{reviewCount}, #{modelVersion}, #{status}, #{lastReviewUpdatedAt}, #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = VALUES(summary), positive_points = VALUES(positive_points), negative_points = VALUES(negative_points), recommended_for = VALUES(recommended_for), keywords = VALUES(keywords), review_count = VALUES(review_count), model_version = VALUES(model_version), status = VALUES(status), last_review_updated_at = VALUES(last_review_updated_at), error_message = VALUES(error_message)

INSERT INTO place_review_summaries ( place_id, summary, positive_points, negative_points, recommended_for, keywords, review_count, model_version, status, last_review_updated_at, error_message ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, NULL, JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), 0, #{modelVersion}, 'PROCESSING', NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE model_version = VALUES(model_version), status = VALUES(status), error_message = NULL

INSERT INTO place_review_summaries ( place_id, summary, positive_points, negative_points, recommended_for, keywords, review_count, model_version, status, last_review_updated_at, error_message ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, NULL, JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), JSON_ARRAY(), 0, #{modelVersion}, 'FAILED', NULL, #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE model_version = VALUES(model_version), status = VALUES(status), error_message = VALUES(error_message)
mapper.select: SELECT id AS review_id, content, rating_score, visited_at, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
